reviewItem.question: For "Experimental Channel Resources (TLSRoute and TCPRoute): In v3, the Kubernetes Gateway API provider does not enable support for the experimental channel API…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: In v3 the Kubernetes Gateway API provider no longer enables experimental channel resources (TLSRoute, TCPRoute) by default; set providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel to true to enable them.
